houseRules.metadataDescription: Review the house rules for Hurghada Vacation Homes, including check-in times, visitor policy, apartment care, cleaning, laundry, and safety guidance.
houseRules.intro: Welcome. We hope you have a comfortable and enjoyable stay. Please note that these are self-catering apartments, so hotel services are not provided.
rules: Check-in and Check-out
Check-in starts from 2:00 PM. Check-out is before 12:00 PM noon.
Visitors, Parties, and Events
Visitors are not permitted. Parties and events are not allowed.
Pets
Pets are not allowed inside the apartment.
Bed Linen Care
Please do not decorate the bed linen with flowers, as this may cause permanent stains.
Smoking
Smoking is permitted only in designated areas. Please dispose of cigarette butts responsibly.
Quiet Hours
Please respect your neighbours by keeping noise to a minimum, especially during the evening and night.
Apartment and Resort Care
Treat the apartment and resort with the same care and respect as you would your own home.
Air Conditioning
Please switch off the air conditioning whenever you leave the apartment.
Damage or Breakages
If anything is damaged or broken during your stay, please inform us immediately so we can arrange repairs.
Clean Floors
Please do not throw food on the floor.
Rubbish Disposal
For rubbish disposal, please use the garbage collection tube located on the wall behind the elevator.
Children
Children must be supervised by their parents or guardians at all times.
Conserve Utilities
Please help us conserve water and electricity.
Bathroom Use
Do not flush toilet paper or other items down the toilet. Please use the waste bin provided.
paidServices: Laundry service is available for an additional charge.
Apartment cleaning, including fresh bed linen and towels, is available for an additional charge.
houseRules.serviceBody: For laundry or apartment cleaning requests, contact our team.
houseRules.thankYou: Thank you for respecting these house rules. We appreciate your cooperation and wish you a pleasant stay.
